notes: Comprehensive collection of 100 Colorado animal welfare organizations including municipal shelters, humane societies, breed-specific rescues, wildlife rehabilitation centers, farm sanctuaries, horse rescues, TNR programs, spay/neuter clinics, and small animal rescues. Coverage spans Denver metro, Colorado Springs, Boulder, Fort Collins, mountain communities, Western Slope, and Eastern Plains. Humane Colorado (formerly Denver Dumb Friends League, founded 1910) is the largest independent shelter in the Rocky Mountain region. Wild Animal Sanctuary in Keenesburg is one of the largest carnivore sanctuaries in the world.
